BEYOND THE FRONT DOOR

A village with a life of its own.

Nobleton’s settlement history reaches back to 1812. Today, its established amenities and community traditions are part of the appeal.

Outside, more often

Explore Tasca Park, Nobleton Community Park and King Township’s parks and trails. Cold Creek offers another place to plan time outdoors. Check current access and facilities before visiting.

Parks & recreation guide

A connected everyday life

Highway 27 and King Road connect the village to surrounding communities. King City GO is a regional rail option; check current routes, parking and train times for your own commute.

Local services & connections

Traditions worth sharing

The Nobleton Victoria Day Fair has been celebrated for more than 50 years, with a parade, entertainment and fireworks. Use the organizer’s calendar for each year’s arrangements.

Community events

Plan the practical details

Explore schools, the library and everyday services alongside the home itself. School eligibility and transportation need address-specific confirmation.

Moving to Nobleton checklist
What about future transport improvements?

Metrolinx plans more two-way, all-day service on the Barrie Line. Ontario is advancing Highway 413. These are future projects; this guide does not assume a completion date or a travel-time saving for Cavallo residents.

Barrie Line GO Expansion · Highway 413 project updates

Start a conversation with Katerina

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

Bring these questions to the conversation.

The full price

Which home and lot does the price cover? What is included, and which premiums, taxes, rebates or adjustments affect the total?

The exact layout

How is floor area measured? Which basement, garage and finish options belong to this model? Ask for the dated plans and specifications.

Deposits & timing

What are the payment milestones and proposed closing dates? Have your lawyer explain the agreement and any provisions for delays.

Your wider move

How do financing, a current-home sale and moving arrangements fit together? Review your circumstances with your real estate and mortgage professionals.

CLEAR ANSWERS

Cavallo, at a glance.

What is Cavallo Estates?

Cavallo Estates is Treasure Hill’s new detached-home community at Highway 27 and Fairmont Ridge Trail in Nobleton, King Township. Bungalows and two- and three-car garage options are part of the announced offering.

What is the advertised starting price?

Treasure Hill advertises a starting price of $999,900, checked November 19, 2026. Ask for the current written price list and confirm the selected home, lot premiums, taxes, rebate assumptions, upgrades and closing adjustments. The headline price is not a complete purchase-cost estimate.

When are closings expected?

CavalloNobleton.com reports that closings could begin in spring 2028. Katerina’s broker-presentation notes indicate summer 2028. Ask Treasure Hill for the written closing dates for your home and lot.

Can I see floor plans and the deposit schedule?

Ask Katerina for the latest builder-issued package for the home type you are considering. This guide does not publish a model-by-model price list, deposit schedule or live lot inventory. Availability must be confirmed for the current release.

Is this the builder’s website?

No. Nobleton.ca is an independent community guide. This page connects buyers with Ekaterina (Katerina) Ottchenach of HomeLife Frontier Realty Inc., Brokerage. It does not imply builder representation, exclusive allocations or priority access.
